newsitem.title: DUBAI: GCC oil ministers meeting in Oman postponed.
newsitem.headline: GCC oil ministers meeting in Oman postponed.

text.p: A meeting of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) oil ministers originally set for June 10 in Gulf Arab Oman has been postponed until September or October, an Omani petroleum official said on Monday.
"The meeting has been postponed may be till September or October. It's not finalised," the official said.
"Some of them (GCC oil ministers) are busy and it is not an urgent matter. It's normal that a meeting can be postponed."

OPEC ministers -- including those from GCC states Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates and Qatar -- are set to meet in Vienna on June 25 to set the group's supply ceiling for the remainder of this year.
Non-OPEC Oman and Bahrain are also members of the GCC, a political and economic body of oil-rich Gulf states.
